text_block_list.text:
In the cafeteria, I spotted Air Groove 
talking with the dormitory heads about 
something.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Introducing luxury brands is simply not 
realistic after all."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, many of the girls at this academy 
come from good families. Finding the right 
balance to satisfy them without blowing 
the budget will be tough...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, we're gettin' nowhere! You're 
obsessing over the tiny details way too 
much anyway!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Can't I just scrub the tail vigorously and 
blast it dry?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
An unkempt coat will affect your running. 
Choosing the right grooming supplies is 
not to be taken lightly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Nn... Oh, you were listening?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey there. I'm borrowing your trainee for 
a bit. I needed some advice from her in my 
capacity as student council vice 
president, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there have been a lot of 
requests to increase the variety of 
tail-care products available in the dorm's 
large bathhouse.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The tail is an essential organ for us. It 
affects our entire body's balance, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If your tail isn't in good condition, you 
might not even be able to put full power 
into your legs.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Tail care is essential, especially for 
Umamusume running in races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is why many bring along carefully 
selected masterpieces, but... not everyone 
has the means to do so.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess it's only right to make sure 
we've got all their backs, no matter their 
circumstances...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's just way too much variety~! 
There's no way to pick something that 
satisfies everyone!
choice_data_list: I'll think about it with you, too.

Everyone has it pretty rough, don't 
they...

text_block_list.text:

There's no way to pick something that 
satisfies everyone!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"What, you? No, but... you don't even have 
a tail, do you?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, no, maybe there are insights that you 
can only offer precisely because you don't 
have one?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, you have a point... I suppose. 
Trainer or not, you do know Umamusume 
well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alright, in that case, I request your 
cooperation. First, sharing the feedback 
gathered from the two of them—

I joined the meeting with Air Groove and 
the others, offering my thoughts from a 
Trainer's perspective whenever 
appropriate.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for your help in the cafeteria. 
Looks like we're ready to finalize the 
introduction of the new care supplies."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yet while having it is natural for us, it 
is rather curious to think that you don't.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you had a tail...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Every morning, I feel like I'd want to 
complain about the state of their fur.

Having said that, Air Groove chuckled with 
a bit of amusement.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I suppose you all have your own 
struggles, just as we have ours."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I forgot to ask... 
How do you take care of Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Me? I am—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's soap.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wh... Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahaha! Are you made of soap or 
something?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And here she looks like she uses super 
expensive hair treatments! Ahhahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wha—what are you laughing at?! Naturally 
derived soap, you see, is...!!

"...Seeing the Umamusume giving it their 
all even in places out of sight, I found a 
renewed resolve to do my best for them."

Today, Air Groove will likely brush her 
tail with her favorite soap and give it 
thorough care once again...
